title: The Nest Among the Stars
old_p1: Obadiah was a prophet, a man Heavenly Father sent to tell His words. His book is the shortest in the Old Testament. It is about Edom, a people who lived high in the mountains.
They made homes in the clefts of the rock, which are cracks in tall cliffs. Up there they felt safe and proud. They said, “Who can bring me down?”
old_p2: Proud means thinking you are better than others. Heavenly Father said, “Though you rise up like the eagle and set your nest among the stars, I will bring you down.”
Eagles build nests way up high where no one can reach. Heavenly Father used that picture because Edom thought they were too high for anyone.
Heavenly Father loves humble hearts that do not think they are better. Tonight, snuggle down low under your covers and feel how good close is.
p1: Obadiah told what Heavenly Father said about the people of Edom. They were unkind to their own family, the people of Israel.
Edom lived high in the mountains, in homes in the rocky cliffs. Up there, they felt safe. They felt proud, like they needed no one.
They said, “Who can bring me down?”
p2: Heavenly Father answered, “You may fly high like an eagle. You may make your nest among the stars. But I will bring you down.” Eagles build their nests way up high. Edom thought no one could reach them. But Heavenly Father can reach everyone.
He wanted Edom to be humble, to know they needed Him. Tonight you can say, “Heavenly Father, I need You. Please help me be kind.”
